faqs.question: How do I know this screen fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the 2020 IdeaPad Flex 5-14 models: 14IIL05, 14ARE05, 14ITL05 and 14ALC05 (machine types 81WS/81X1, 81X2/82DF, 82HS and 82HU). It does not fit the older Flex 5-1470 or Flex 5-1480. Send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm before you order.

faqs.question: Is this the complete touch screen assembly?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is the FHD LCD with touch digitizer and front bezel, with a 30-pin connector, so it replaces the whole screen section in one piece.

faqs.question: Do you install the screen, or is it self-fit?
faqs.answer: We can install it for you in Nairobi, or ship it with fitting instructions if you're upcountry or prefer your own technician.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this screen?
faqs.answer: This screen carries a 3-month warranty against dead pixels and panel defects.
